stories.title: English-speaking, Texan and from vulnerable backgrounds: The Americans still accessing abortion thanks to Mexican feminists

en.title: English-speaking, Texan and from vulnerable backgrounds: The Americans still accessing abortion thanks to Mexican feminists
en.summary: After Roe v. Wade was overturned, American women from disadvantaged backgrounds have been accessing abortion services with assistance from Mexican feminist organizations. Research documents the characteristics and experiences of these women denied abortion access in the United States.

stories.title: Operation Save the Yen: Japan partially turns off the cheap money tap, with a little help from its ‘American friend’

en.title: Operation Save the Yen: Japan partially turns off the cheap money tap, with a little help from its 'American friend'
en.summary: The Bank of Japan has raised interest rates in coordination with the Federal Reserve to address the yen's depreciation and control inflation. The policy adjustment represents a shift away from the prolonged period of cheap money.
